description: Sky circles excised from PSF stars and galaxies in the rho/tau PSF-leakage measurement. A row is removed when its angular separation from a circle centre (ICRS degrees) is less than radius_deg. M33 contaminates the PSF stars (CosmoStat/sp_validation#452); M101, M13 and M92 are conservative crowding or extended-source excisions.
